about.title: About Azmera
about.page_description: Learn about our mission to transform Ethiopian agriculture
about.hero_description: A comprehensive digital platform connecting farmers, buyers, and service providers to create a transparent and efficient agricultural marketplace.
about.problem_subtitle: Major agricultural challenges hindering smallholder farmer prosperity
about.problem1: Smallholder farmers lack fair market access and real-time pricing information
about.problem2: Limited access to reliable buyers, reducing bargaining power
about.problem3: Significant post-harvest losses (up to 30%) due to inefficient logistics
about.problem4: Absence of modern, accessible digital tools for farm planning
about.problem5: Fragmented efforts leading to uncoordinated planting and resource use
about.solution_subtitle: An integrated digital platform addressing key agricultural pain points
about.solution_description: Azmera is a comprehensive digital ecosystem designed to foster direct connections, provide access to information, streamline processes, and build trust.
about.feature_marketplace_desc: Directly connect farmers with buyers for transparent transactions
about.feature_ai_planner_desc: Smart group planning and resource scheduling for cooperatives
about.feature_ai_advisor_desc: Diagnose pests/diseases and get AI-driven pricing forecasts
about.feature_ai_desc: Smart farming assistance powered by AI
about.feature_logistics_desc: Book and manage transport, reducing spoilage
about.feature_mobile_desc: Accessible even in areas with limited connectivity
about.feature_escrow_desc: Secure payments released only upon delivery confirmation
about.feature_learning_desc: Engaging training on modern farming techniques
about.key_pricing_desc: AI suggestions for optimal pricing, increasing profitability
about.key_cooperative_desc: AI-driven group planning for planting and collective sales
about.key_matching_desc: Efficiently connects verified buyers with suitable farmers
about.key_dashboard_desc: Live data on prices, demand, and supply across regions
about.key_delivery_desc: Seamless booking and tracking of transporters
about.key_language_desc: Ensures inclusivity with local language UIs
about.key_escrow_desc: Builds trust by holding payments until delivery confirmed
about.key_advisor_desc: Quick image-based diagnosis and actionable solutions
about.how_it_works_subtitle: A streamlined and trustworthy process from planning to payment
about.step1_desc: Create verified profiles and list produce or join cooperatives
about.step2_desc: Use AI Planner, browse listings, and place orders
about.step3_desc: Buyer pays, funds held securely in escrow
about.step5_desc: Funds automatically released, all parties can rate
about.market_subtitle: The potential for Azmera in Ethiopia
about.market_youth_value: Over 60% of population under 25, increasingly tech-savvy
about.market_gap_value: Huge untapped potential for digital solutions
about.revenue_commission_desc: Small percentage on successful marketplace sales
about.revenue_premium_desc: Advanced AI tools and detailed market analytics
about.revenue_logistics_desc: Small markup on coordinated transport services
about.revenue_advertising_desc: Platform for relevant ads from verified suppliers
about.revenue_analytics_desc: Anonymized market trend reports for institutions
about.business_model_note: Our model focuses on creating value for all stakeholders
about.gtm_subtitle: Our phased approach to user acquisition and market penetration
about.phase1_desc: Collaborate with cooperatives, NGOs, and agricultural offices
about.phase2_desc: Utilize extension agents and community leaders for awareness
about.phase3_desc: Expand geographically and enhance AI features
about.security_subtitle: Building a safe and reliable platform for all users
about.security_escrow: Secure escrow system protecting all parties
about.cta_description: Be part of the digital transformation of Ethiopian agriculture. Connect with thousands of farmers, buyers, and service providers.
about.status_subtitle: Live metrics from the Azmera ecosystem
about.roadmap_subtitle: Our roadmap for the future of Ethiopian agriculture
about.roadmap_q1_desc: Native iOS and Android applications for offline access
about.roadmap_q3_desc: End-to-end supply chain tracking on blockchain
about.mission_desc: To democratize access to agricultural markets and technology for every Ethiopian farmer.
about.vision_desc: A thriving, connected, and prosperous agricultural sector that feeds the nation and the world.
